newsitem.title: USA: Harleysville sets special cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Harleysville sets special cash dividend.

text.p: Harleysville National Corp said Monday that its board has approved a special cash dividend of $0.04 per share to shareholders of record December 13, payable December 31.

"We achieved record earnings in each of the first three quarters of 1996 in addition to reaching $1 billion in consolidated total assets," Chief Executive Walter Daller said in a release. "We are pleased to share these accomplishments with our deserving shareholders."
The company last month reported third quarter earnings of $0.53 per share, up from $0.46 in the year-ago period.
The company said its board also declared its regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.21 per share.
